Voici votre chance de vivre une aventure professionnelle unique !

Ensemble, cultivons l’art de faire rêver pour donner vie à la magie. À Disneyland Paris, nos équipes mettent leur expertise au service d’un environnement en constante évolution. Chaque jour, elles contribuent à donner vie à la magie grâce à leur savoir-faire et à la force du collectif, tout en façonnant le futur de notre destination. Nous rejoindre, c’est évoluer dans un cadre multiculturel riche et inclusif, où chacun et chacune peut déployer son talent.

Votre environnement:

Notre direction Technology est en charge de l’ensemble des solutions informatiques de Disneyland Paris.

Au sein de cette Direction, le département E-commerce gère tous les sites web marketing & e-commerce ainsi que l'application mobile pour nos visiteurs.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Lead Developer passionné(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe de développement E-Commerce et travailler sur de nombreux projets à fort trafic !

Vos missions ?

En tant que Lead Developer, vous alliez une approche pratique et experte de l'ingénierie à des compétences en leadership technique. Vous piloterez la conception des solutions, renforcerez les pratiques d'ingénierie, encadrerez les développeurs et contribuerez à garantir la mise en œuvre et le bon fonctionnement des différents projets.

Votre environnement technique :

Langage: JavaScript, TypeScript

Frameworks: React, Next.js

Architecture: REST APIs, OpenAPI

Cloud et DevOps: AWS,CDN, Terraform

Chaîne d’outils: GitHub / Gitlab, CI/CD orchestrator (Harness, Gitlab CI, ..),, Nexus, Docker

Monitoring: Splunk, Grafana, AppDynamics, CloudWatch

Méthodos/pratiques: Agile, CI/CD, Tests automatisés, développement sécurisé

Vos principales missions consisteront à :

•

Superviser la conception de solutions pour des applications, services et des intégrations à grande échelle.

•

Apporter une contribution technique concrète pour les composants complexes ou à haut risque.

•

Orienter les décisions architecturales au sein de l’équipe et veiller à leur conformité avec les normes de l’entreprise.

•

Mettre en place et renforcer les normes de codage, les pratiques de code review et les process.

•

Piloter l’estimation, la qualité de la livraison et la gestion des risques techniques pour l’ensemble des projets.

•

Accompagner les développeurs par le biais de revues de code, de travail en binôme, de coaching et de retours techniques constructifs.

•

Promouvoir les pratiques de développement sécurisé, les tests automatisés, la CI/CD, l’observabilité et la préparation opérationnelle.

•

Soutenir la gestion des incidents, l’analyse des causes profondes, l’amélioration des performances et les initiatives en matière de fiabilité.

•

Évaluer les technologies approuvées et les pratiques d’ingénierie assistées par l’IA susceptibles d’améliorer la qualité, le flux de travail et la productivité des développeurs.

•

Assumer le rôle de responsable technique principal pour l’écosystème Front-End et eCommerce, en définissant la stratégie de la plateforme, les feuilles de route de modernisation, les normes d’ingénierie, l’adoption de l’IA et l’orientation architecturale pour l’ensemble des équipes produit et des services partagés.

•

Promouvoir l’ingénierie logicielle assistée par l’IA et « agentique », l’amélioration de la productivité des développeurs, l’automatisation des plateformes et les pratiques modernes de livraison logicielle à l’échelle de l’organisation.

•

Maîtriser la stratégie technique et la feuille de route des projets en veillant à leur alignement sur les priorités métier, les exigences d’évolutivité, les objectifs de modernisation des plateformes et la pérennité à long terme.

De la flexibilité, de l’autonomie et de la confiance vous seront données ;

Une intégration technologique qui suit les évolutions du marché

•

Vous maîtrisez l'anglais et le français de façon courante, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral (niveau C1)

Vous avez de solides connaissances en architecture logicielle, en modèles de conception, en développement cloud-native et en conception d'API.

•

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités à accompagner les équipes et faire preuve de persuasion dans des décisions techniques.

•

Expérience dans les opérations de production, la gestion des incidents et l'analyse des causes profondes.

•

Vous avez d’excellentes compétences en communication, que ce soit avec des interlocuteurs techniques ou non techniques.

•

Vous avez l’habitude de travailler avec des équipes de développement internationales et/ou externalisées

Vous réussirez dans ce rôle si :

•

Votre façon de leader est basée sur la crédibilité technique, la collaboration et une prise de décision claire.

•

Au quotidien vous recherchez le juste équilibre entre les délais de livraison, la qualité, la sécurité, la performance et la pérennité des solutions.

•

Vous savez prendre des décisions pragmatiques, expliquer les compromis et gérer les risques techniques en toute transparence.

•

•

Vous avez à cœur de promouvoir une culture inclusive fondée sur la responsabilisation, l'apprentissage continu et l'amélioration continue.

La différence Disneyland Paris ?

Une session d'intégration complète et un large éventail d'options de formation pour le développement des compétences

•

De nombreuses possibilités de carrière (promotion interne ou mobilité horizontale)

•

Un environnement exceptionnel, international et multiculturel concentré sur un site unique.

•

L'opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise unique à un moment charnière, avec notamment l'extension du futur Disney Adventure World, en travaillant à l'amélioration de l'expérience de nos visiteurs, y compris sur le plan numérique.

📝Ce poste est un contrat en CDI au statut cadre

📍 Ce poste est basé à Montévrain, à quelques minutes à pieds de la station Val d’Europe, sur le RER A.

The AppSec Security Engineer evaluates service design and architecture and performs deep-dive security assessments to ensure applications and services meet a high security bar before launch. This role works alongside senior engineers to identify issues, drive remediation, and validate that security requirements are met.

Key job responsibilities
- Security Reviews: Conduct design reviews for new and existing services, evaluating architecture documents and system designs for security risks.
- Threat Modelling: Identify attack vectors and security weaknesses in application architectures through structured threat modelling exercises.
- Penetration Testing: Coordinate penetration testing to validate security controls and identify exploitable vulnerabilities.
- Finding Management: Document, track, and communicate security findings to service teams with clear remediation guidance, and verify fixes are implemented.
- Security Guidance: Advise development teams on secure coding practices, authentication/authorization mechanisms, cryptographic implementations, and data protection strategies.
- Escalation Support: Identify and escalate high-severity issues through appropriate channels, ensuring timely remediation aligned with launch timelines.
- Documentation: Maintain clear documentation of review outcomes, security decisions, and risk assessments.
- Tool Improvements: Leverage automated tools to support reviews and improve efficiency.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We build and run the secure execution environment behind Claude's agentic capabilities. When Claude writes and runs code, browses the web, or uses a computer, that happens on infrastructure our team owns. We work at the intersection of systems engineering and security. The goal is to make untrusted code execution safe, fast, and reliable enough that product teams don't have to think about it. This is the layer between the model and the outside world, and it has to hold up at scale for every Anthropic product. We're hiring engineers who have experience building for containerized workloads and have a keen eye for building products used by millions of customers.

What you'll do

You'll independently scope complex, multi-month projects, drive cross-org alignment through ambiguous problem spaces, and make architectural decisions that shape how Anthropic builds and scales its products. You'll partner directly with research to productize cutting-edge capabilities, and will have lasting impact on the platform that hundreds of thousands of companies and internal/external engineers depend on every day.

You might be a good fit if you:

• Have a minimum of 8 years of practical experience as a backend or platform engineer building scalable distributed systems, ideally operating at tech lead level or equivalent distributed systems, cloud-native products, developer tools, or external developer facing products
• Have strong fundamentals in service-oriented architectures, networking, and systems design, ideally having owned both the technical vision and execution of a foundational platform system end to end
• Are proficient in Python, Go, Rust, or similar systems languages
• Have experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS, or Azure), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and/or multi-cloud networking
• Take full ownership of your work—from design through deployment and operations
• Can navigate ambiguity and make sound technical decisions independently, and have ideally operated in 0 to 1 and more mature team or company settings
• Take a product-focused approach to platform work and care about building solutions that are robust, scalable, and easy to us

An integral part of a Senior Associate’s role is assisting with client relationship management, sustaining relationships with senior executives and guiding candidates through their recruitment journey.

While learning the Search industry, Senior Associates invest significant time researching and learning about various industries, executive roles and functions, and do so in collaboration with colleagues across the globe. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
The PPE (Payments, Protection & Experience) Fraud team plays a critical role in protecting Coupang customers, sellers, and the business from fraudulent activities while maintaining a seamless customer experience. By leveraging data, analytics, and scalable data solutions, the team identifies fraud patterns, measures risk, and enables data-driven decision-making across Fraud Operations, Product, Engineering, and Risk stakeholders.
This role combines strong business analytics capabilities with data engineering expertise. The position focuses on designing scalable data solutions, building and maintaining robust data pipelines, and delivering actionable insights that drive fraud prevention strategies and operational excellence. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable translating fraud-related business requirements into data solutions and developing reliable, efficient backend data systems that support risk management and fraud detection.
What You Will Do
Business Partnership & Solution Design
Collaborate closely with Fraud Operations, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, dashboards, and analytical solutions.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify fraud patterns, loss drivers, operational inefficiencies, and emerging risk trends.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders on strategic initiatives to investigate, prevent, and mitigate fraud-related challenges.
Develop fraud performance metrics and reporting frameworks to measure the effectiveness of fraud detection and prevention efforts.
Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and datasets supporting fraud analytics, investigations, and risk decisioning.
Develop new data ingestion pipelines, including integrations with internal and external data sources using Python.
Ensure reliability of fraud data systems by monitoring pipelines, troubleshooting failures, and maintaining business-critical datasets.
Data Quality & Governance
Implement robust data quality monitoring and validation frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency of fraud-related reporting.
Maintain and enhance core fraud and risk datasets to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Manage data lineage documentation and establish clear visibility into data sources, transformations, and downstream usage.
Performance Optimization
Optimize data processing workflows and warehouse performance through advanced SQL tuning and query optimization.
Continuously improve existing datasets, data infrastructure, and reporting tools to increase scalability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.
Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual processes and improve operational productivity.
Scalable Analytics Enablement
Build self-service dashboards and scalable reporting solutions that empower stakeholders to monitor fraud performance and key risk indicators.
Enable faster and more effective decision-making through automated reporting and analytical frameworks.
Support experimentation and measurement initiatives to evaluate fraud controls, policy changes, and product enhancements.
Continuous Improvement
Stay current with industry best practices, fraud detection methodologies, and emerging data technologies.
Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen fraud analytics capabilities, data infrastructure, and risk management processes.
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Fraud Analytics, Risk Analytics, Data Engineering, or related quantitative fields.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex fraud and business challenges into actionable insights.
Advanced SQL skills
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, dashboards, and scalable reporting solutions.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical concepts and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡에서는 Household & Personal Care (HPC) 카테고리를 담당하실 Brand Manager를 채용하고 있습니다.
